# Client -> server opcodes built inside the game subsystem (0x142c..0x142e)
#
# Filtered out of research/msexe-send-opcodes.txt by builder address. The game
# dispatcher FUN_142cbaa80 and the world object DAT_143aa84a0 live in this range,
# so these are what a CHANNEL should expect to receive once a character is in a map.
# The login subsystem (0x141b) builds a separate, disjoint set.
#
